stories.title: 尹锡悦接受免费舆论调查服务案二审改判无罪

en.title: Yoon Suk-yeol acquitted on appeal in case of receiving free opinion survey services
en.summary: South Korea's former president Yoon Suk-yeol was acquitted on appeal in a case involving allegations that he received free opinion survey services. Some guilty verdicts from the initial trial were overturned.

stories.title: France halts use of stun grenades in policing of student protests

en.title: France halts use of stun grenades in policing of student protests
en.summary: France suspended stun grenade use during student protest policing following an incident where a 15-year-old's hand was severely injured. Student protests continue with hundreds of schools closed and additional demonstrations planned.

stories.title: WTT中国大满贯赛：孙颖莎出局 中国台北小将淘汰梁靖崑

en.title: WTT China Grand Slam: Sun Yingsha eliminated, Chinese Taipei player ousts Liang Jingkun
en.summary: At the 2026 WTT China Grand Slam in Beijing, Sun Yingsha lost to Thailand's Paranang 1-3 in round 16, while Liang Jingkun fell to Chinese Taipei's Kuo Kuan-hung 1-3, exiting at the round of 32.

stories.title: 国庆假期约140.6万人次内地旅客入境香港

en.title: Approximately 1.406 million mainland Chinese visitors entered Hong Kong during National Day holiday
en.summary: Hong Kong received approximately 1.406 million mainland Chinese visitors during the October 1-7 National Day holiday period, according to government immigration officials.

stories.title: 泰国洪灾死亡人数升至60人 多地将迎新一轮强降雨

en.title: Thailand flood death toll rises to 60, multiple regions to face new heavy rainfall
en.summary: Thailand's death toll from flooding that began on September 16 has reached 60, with the capital Bangkok and 27 provinces affected. Authorities continue drainage, rescue, and relief operations across the country.

stories.title: 量子精密测量实现新突破 我国科研团队研制出“核光钟”

en.title: Quantum precision measurement achieves breakthrough as Chinese research team develops "nuclear optical clock"
en.summary: A Chinese research team led by Tsinghua University has developed the world's first "nuclear optical clock," advancing quantum precision measurement from electron transitions to nuclear transitions. The breakthrough opens new technological pathways for next-generation timekeeping systems, deep space exploration, and fundamental physics research.

stories.title: Singapore’s air pollution worst in world as haze shuts Malaysia schools

en.title: Singapore's air pollution worst in world as haze shuts Malaysia schools
en.summary: Indonesian wildfires have created haze blanketing the region, causing Singapore to experience the worst air quality globally, with levels in the "very unhealthy" range. The pollution has led to school closures in Malaysia's Johor state and impacts the region ahead of Singapore's Formula One weekend.

stories.title: China’s thorium-229 nuclear clock beats Vienna’s on stability, studies show

en.title: China's thorium-229 nuclear clock beats Vienna's on stability, studies show
en.summary: Initial results from the world's first two operating nuclear clocks show China's device, developed by Tsinghua University, is approximately six times more stable than Vienna's comparable timepiece. Both clocks use thorium-229 nuclei embedded in crystals to measure time through atomic core rhythms.

stories.title: 10 injured in knife attack at school in northeastern Poland

en.title: 10 injured in knife attack at school in northeastern Poland
en.summary: A knife attack at a school in Ostroleka, Poland wounded ten people including five students, two teachers, two bystanders, and the suspect. Police detained the 19-year-old attacker, and nine victims were hospitalized with no life-threatening injuries reported.

stories.title: 24 luxury houses at One Stanley sold amid probe into alleged construction defects

en.title: 24 luxury houses at One Stanley sold amid probe into alleged construction defects
en.summary: Twenty-four luxury residences at One Stanley in Hong Kong have been sold since authorities began investigating structural defects in March. Experts are calling for enhanced buyer protections, including mandatory contract rescission periods when statutory violations are identified.

stories.title: More than 300 hopefuls sign up for Hong Kong’s Election Committee poll

en.title: More than 300 hopefuls sign up for Hong Kong's Election Committee poll
en.summary: Over 300 candidates registered for Hong Kong's Election Committee election during the nomination period opening on Wednesday. The 1,500-member committee will select the city's next chief executive in March next year.

stories.title: Hong Kong tech index to harness fast-growth companies in bid for better performance

en.title: Hong Kong tech index to harness fast-growth companies in bid for better performance
en.summary: Hong Kong's stock index compiler will add 10 fast-growing companies with at least HK$500 million in annual sales to its technology benchmark. The reform aims to revitalise the Hang Seng Tech Index, which has underperformed global peers and missed gains from artificial intelligence trends.

stories.title: Why Morgan Stanley sees more upside in Hong Kong offices than New York towers

en.title: Why Morgan Stanley sees more upside in Hong Kong offices than New York towers
en.summary: Morgan Stanley believes Hong Kong's office market has greater upside potential than New York despite higher interest rates affecting both property markets. The investment bank notes similarities between the two financial centers, including aligned monetary policies and limited land supply.

stories.title: Family offices branch out into private equity, infrastructure and alternative investments

en.title: Family offices branch out into private equity, infrastructure and alternative investments
en.summary: Asian family offices led by second and third-generation owners are expanding into diverse investment areas including private equity and infrastructure rather than abandoning founding principles. These investors continue assessing opportunities and adjusting portfolios for optimal risk-return balance.

stories.title: Asian investors turn to housing, real assets as global tension shakes market confidence

en.title: Asian investors turn to housing, real assets as global tension shakes market confidence
en.summary: Asian investors are shifting away from private credit toward real estate and other real assets amid macroeconomic uncertainties. Interest in real estate rose to 52 percent from 39 percent while private credit interest dropped significantly to 48 percent from 71 percent.

stories.title: US firm ArriVent’s plunge shows risks facing China’s biotech expansion into global markets

en.title: US firm ArriVent's plunge shows risks facing China's biotech expansion into global markets
en.summary: ArriVent BioPharma's stock fell nearly 47 percent after its cancer drug firmonertinib, licensed from Shanghai Allist Pharmaceuticals, failed to meet primary objectives in a phase 3 trial. The setback illustrates challenges Chinese biotech companies face when expanding internationally.
